verdicts.reason: A and B are pixel-identical. In both, the stained-glass window is stretched wider than its original proportions (the arch looks squat and the cross bar runs past the right edge of the window). The window fills most of the canvas and dwarfs the headline. The date and address are tiny, oddly offset from each other (the date is indented and the address is flush left) and crammed under the window with almost no gap. The whole block is shifted left, leaving the right margin uneven.
